# Demand exploration

## Procedure
1. Report training weeks and total/average weekly orders.
2. Aggregate demand by week, category, meal, and center.
3. Calculate shares and cumulative shares; clearly state the population behind each percentage.
4. Calculate meal-level weekly coefficient of variation as standard deviation divided by mean.
5. Rank inventory attention using both demand volume and volatility, not CV alone.
6. Create at least four labeled PNG charts and export supporting tables.
7. Mention that week numbers are not calendar dates and missing combinations are not automatically zero demand.
